title: policy-templating-safeguard-orchestrator-for-private-installer
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds a policy templating compiler and a reconcile orchestrator for private installer Helm charts to generate tenant-scoped minimal RBAC bundles and safely reconcile them during upgrades. Opt-in via values.policyTemplating.enabled=false->true. Includes a dry-run reconciler and peaceful rollback support.
description: Motivation: Private clusters have repeated manual RBAC changes and upgrade-time drift that increase operational overhead and incident risk. This PR implements a small policy templating compiler and a Helm hook-based reconcile orchestrator so tenant RBAC bundles can be generated, validated, and applied idempotently at install/upgrade time. The orchestrator also records reconciliation status for operator tooling and supports dry-run verification and safe rollback annotations. Key changes: a Go-based policy-templating CLI that expands parameterized role/clusterrole templates into tenant-scoped manifests; Helm hooks (post-install/post-upgrade) that run a reconcile job and emit a reconciliation ConfigMap per tenant; a terraform modules update that optionally renders templates during plan/apply to detect drift early; conservative conflict detection to avoid accidental overwrite of pre-existing cluster roles; unit and integration tests including a KIND-based smoke test and helm unittest harness. Backwards compatibility: the feature is opt-in and disabled by default. Operators must enable values.policyTemplating.enabled to activate the reconcile orchestrator; recommended rollout is to run dry-run first then enable. Migration notes and operator steps are included in docs/migration/policy-templating.md.

review_comments: Daniel Kim: Please ensure the reconcile job has a clear activeDeadlineSeconds and will not leak resources if the API is slow. Also add a metrics emission for reconcile duration.
Priya Menon: Added activeDeadlineSeconds=900 and a backoff policy; added prometheus metric rbac_reconcile_duration_seconds. Documented operator expectations for API latency.
Maya Sundar: Make secret/KMS reads optional for terraform plan stage; preventing secret exposure during plan is important.
Priya Menon: Terraform module now accepts skip_secret_lookup=true and reads encrypted references only when explicitly enabled. Added notes in migration doc.
Eric Zhao: CI saw flakiness in KIND cluster startup causing integration failures earlier; any mitigations?
Priya Menon: Increased KIND startup timeout and gated the e2e behind a CI flag to reduce flakes. Integration tests now run with a fixed node count and resource limits.
Security Team: Confirmed least-privilege for generated roles and absence of wildcard verbs on cluster roles by default.
Priya Menon: Security review addressed; templates default to minimal verbs and require explicit opt-in for broader permissions.
merge_commit_message: Add policy-templating compiler and reconcile orchestrator to private installer charts (ENG-2345). Includes TF module and tests.
notes_on_deployment: Operators: enable values.policyTemplating.enabled=true to opt in. Run helm upgrade --install with --wait so the post-upgrade reconcile job can complete. To verify, run kubectl -n redwood get configmap rbac-reconcile-status-<tenant>. For safe rollback, set values.policyTemplating.enabled=false before helm rollback; reconcile job respects peaceful-rollback annotations to avoid destructive deletions.
